title: Quality Metric
description: One quality metric computed for a recording, with exactly one producer. A plugin manifest (nemar-cli shared/contract) declares each of its metric outputs with this shape and names the producer with plugin; recipe is for a metric a recipe writes into its own records.

value.description: The metric's value; null when it could not be computed.

unit.description: Unit of the value (for example %, dB, count).

description.description: One-sentence description of what the metric measures.

bounds.description: The valid range the producer declares for this value (for example 0 to 100 for a percentage), not a quality threshold and not the range observed across recordings (that is the dataset summary's observed_range).

plugin.description: The plugin that produced this value; the producer of every metric a plugin manifest declares. Exactly one of plugin and recipe.

recipe.description: The recipe that produced this value, for a metric a recipe writes into its own records. Exactly one of plugin and recipe.
